summary: An auto-accompaniment arranger inspired by the Yamaha QY70: a style plays an eight-instrument band on General MIDI sounds and follows the chords you play. It also works as a General MIDI sound module.
features: Songs made of sections, with 16 chord progressions
Two grooves per style plus Intro, Fill and Ending, and two melodies
Record into grooves; edited copies stay apart from the style
Can play the QY70's 128 preset styles from your own QY70 ROM
MIDI in on all 16 channels over USB or TRS; external clock
Works with the FM-1 Screen Reader
